newsitem.title: USA: Packard Bell to start direct-sale strategy in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Packard Bell to start direct-sale strategy in Q3.

text.p: Privately-held Packard Bell NEC Inc said Wednesday its computer systems division would start a direct-sale strategy in the third quarter, focusing on small and medium-sized companies.

The direct-sale strategy, dubbed NEC NOW, permits commercial end-users to choose the logistics and pricing of direct sales, integrated with the service and support of the company's resellers, Packard Bell said.

The program focuses on small-and medium-sized companies, the company said, adding it expected state, local and federal government agencies and educational institutions would also buy products via NEC NOW.

The company said it expected to double its sales force on the next few quarters. Under the initiative, Packard Bell will hook up with vertical market-focused resellers who want to represent the company's products.
